questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests must cover distributed transactions with asynchronous callbacks, idempotency keys to avoid duplicates across retries, and cross-region consistency. This mirrors real-world retail/back-office systems at Lyft/Goldman Sachs.

## Key Concepts
- Distributed async workflows
- Idempotency, exactly-once vs at-least-once
- Partial failure simulation (downstream outages)
- Data reconciliation and tombstones
- Latency budgets and observability (SLIs)

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-idempotent processor
function processCheckoutEvent(event, store) {
  const key = event.idempotencyKey;
  if (store.has(key)) return store.get(key); // idempotent
  const res = doWork(event); // triggers downstream
  store.set(key, res);
  return res;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you structure a test to verify exactly-once semantics when events can be delivered multiple times?
- What metrics and dashboards would you use to detect latency regressions in the downstream flow during peak load?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests for idempotency and long-running behavior are common in search APIs and are easy to misconfigure.

## Key Concepts

- Idempotency keys prevent duplicates
- 202 with Location header enables polling
- Polling strategy and eventual consistency
- Rate limiting and Retry-After handling
- Concurrency: distinct keys yield separate jobs

## Code Example

```python
import httpx

def test_idempotent_search():
    client = httpx.Client()
    payload = {"query": "cpu"}
    headers = {"X-Idempotency-Key": "req-1"}
    r1 = client.post("https://api.example.com/api/v1/search", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert r1.status_code == 202
    location = r1.headers["Location"]
    r2 = client.post("https://api.example.com/api/v1/search", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert r2.status_code == 202
    assert r2.headers.get("Location") == location
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test idempotency in a distributed env?
- How to simulate high contention and verify race conditions?
